_comment: Damage values from ROM disassembly (table at $AD20, routine at $AC38). All values are base HP damage against 240 HP max. Damage scales ~20% per 4-match difficulty tier. Great Puma gets 1.25-1.5x multiplier on heavy grapples.

punch.description: Quick standing jab (B button). 4-5 HP damage.

kick.description: Standing kick (A button). 9-11 HP damage, more range than punch.

running_clothesline.description: Running B attack. Clothesline, 16-22 HP. Great Puma: 27 HP.

running_dropkick.description: Running A attack. Flying dropkick, 23-39 HP. Very powerful.

body_slam.description: Win grapple + B. Pick up and slam. 7-10 HP (Great Puma: 12).

irish_whip.description: Win grapple + Left/Right + B. Fling opponent into the ropes. No damage.

brainbuster.description: Win grapple + A. Vertical suplex. 22-30 HP (Great Puma: 37).

back_suplex.description: Win grapple + Left/Right + A. Belly-to-back suplex. 15-20 HP (Great Puma: 25).

piledriver.description: Default Down+A in grapple. 22-37 HP (30 base). Replaced by character signatures.

ground_stomp.description: Stand near downed opponent + B. Ground stomp / knee drop. 21-36 HP.

pin_attempt.description: Stand near downed opponent + A. Initiate pin attempt (3-count).

diving_splash.description: From turnbuckle + A or B. Flying body splash. 36-60 HP. Devastating!

dive_crash.description: Miss the diving splash. Attacker takes ~20 HP and is downed for 2 seconds.

signature_moves._comment: Replace default piledriver for Down+A in grapple. Damage range: 20-34 HP base. See wrestlers.json for assignment.

healthSystem._note: Health regens slowly: heal byte accumulates 6/frame, overflows at 256 (every ~43 frames / 0.71s), restoring 1 HP. Cannot pin for 3-count if opponent HP >= 62.

stunFormulas._comment: Stun duration is dynamic, based on current HP. Lower HP = longer stun.
